Portland General Electric Company First Revision of Sheet No. 121-1
P.U.C. Oregon No. E-19 Canceling Original Sheet No. 121-1
SCHEDULE 121
DISTRIBUTION SYSTEM PLAN ALTERNATIVE RECOVERY MECHANISM
PURPOSE
This Schedule recovers the revenue requirement associated with PGE’s Distribution System Plan.
AVAILABLE
In all territory served by the Company.
APPLICABLE
To all bills for Electricity Service except Schedules 76R, and 576R.
ADJUSTMENT RATE
The Adjustment Rate, applicable for service on and after the effective date of this schedule are:

SPECIAL CONDITIONS
1. Costs recovered through this schedule will be allocated to each schedule using the
applicable schedule’s forecasted energy on the basis of an equal percent of production,
transmission, distribution and consumer revenue applied on a cents per kWh basis to each
applicable rate schedule.
2. The costs for projects included under this schedule will be updated annually as provided
above and will continue to be recovered under Schedule 121 until such time as the costs
are included in base rates.
3. The Company will submit the annual update filing for Schedule 121 no later than the last
business day of February each year.
4. Once the Distribution System Plan is included in base rates or is no longer in service, this
Schedule will be withdrawn, and no other assets will be placed within this Schedule.
Advice No. 26-24
Issued June 30, 2026 Effective for service
Angelica Espinosa, Senior Vice President on and after July 8, 2026
